description: This file contains utility functions, classes, and loaders for handling operator input data, serialization/deserialization of tensors, and logging for PyTorch benchmarks related to Dynamo microbenchmarks.

classes.name: FuncCallWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for serializing function calls with arguments, converting tensor and dtype information into a string representation.

classes.name: OperatorInputsMode
classes.description: A custom TorchDispatchMode that records operator input patterns and counts during tensor operations.

classes.name: OperatorInputsLoader
classes.description: A class for loading, parsing, and querying operator input data from text files for benchmarking and analysis.

methods.name: truncate_inp
methods.description: Converts dtype or device objects into string abbreviations or returns the input unchanged.

methods.name: serialize_sparse_tensor
methods.description: Serializes a sparse tensor or FakeTensor into a FuncCallWrapper object.

methods.name: deserialize_sparse_tensor
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to deserialize sparse tensor data.

methods.name: deserialize_tensor
methods.description: Creates a tensor of specified size and dtype, optionally with a given stride, and copies data into it.

methods.name: serialize_tensor
methods.description: Serializes a tensor into a FuncCallWrapper, considering contiguity.

methods.name: serialize_torch_args
methods.description: Serializes torch.Tensor objects or other arguments for logging.

methods.name: contains_tensor
methods.description: Checks if a nested structure contains any torch.Tensor.

methods.name: skip_args
methods.description: Determines if arguments should be skipped based on their type (e.g., storage or memory format).

methods.name: contains_tensor_types
methods.description: Recursively checks if a type contains tensor types.

methods.name: non_compute_operator
methods.description: Determines if an operator is non-computational based on its schema.

methods.name: __torch_dispatch__
methods.description: Overrides torch dispatch to record operator input patterns.

methods.name: log_to_file
methods.description: Logs recorded operator input patterns to a file.

methods.name: map_to_device
methods.description: Maps an argument to a specified device.

methods.name: map_to_dtype
methods.description: Maps an argument to a specified dtype.

methods.name: deserialize_args
methods.description: Deserializes string representations of arguments into actual tensors or values.

methods.name: get_inputs_for_operator
methods.description: Generator yielding input argument combinations for a given operator, with optional dtype and device adjustments.

methods.name: get_all_ops
methods.description: Yields all operator overloads stored in the database.

methods.name: get_call_frequency
methods.description: Returns the number of times a specific operator was called.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another OperatorInputsLoader's data into this one.

methods.name: _load_directory
methods.description: Loads operator input data from all text files in a directory.
